clauses.title: Scope
clauses.summary: What the standard covers and who can use it.

clauses.title: Normative references
clauses.summary: Other documents the standard relies on.

clauses.title: Terms and definitions
clauses.summary: The words the standard uses and what they mean.

clauses.title: Context of the organization
clauses.summary: Know the organisation, who it answers to and where the system stops.

clauses.title: Understanding the organization and its context
clauses.summary: List the internal and external issues that shape what the system must achieve, and decide whether climate change is one of them.

clauses.title: Understanding the needs and expectations of interested parties
clauses.summary: Name the parties that matter and what each expects; some may have climate-related requirements.

clauses.title: Determining the scope of the quality management system
clauses.summary: Write down the sites, products and services the system covers, and justify any requirement that does not apply.

clauses.title: Quality management system and its processes
clauses.summary: Set up and run the processes the system needs.

clauses.title: Processes of the system
clauses.summary: Name the processes, their inputs, outputs, order, owners and measures.

clauses.title: Documented information on processes
clauses.summary: Keep what is needed to run the processes and show they ran as planned.

clauses.title: Leadership
clauses.summary: Top management leads the system and owns its results.

clauses.title: Leadership and commitment
clauses.summary: Top management is accountable for the system and backs it in practice.

clauses.title: General
clauses.summary: Top management takes part, gives resources and makes the system part of the business.

clauses.title: Customer focus
clauses.summary: Keep customer needs and satisfaction at the centre of decisions.

clauses.title: Policy
clauses.summary: Keep a quality policy that sets direction.

clauses.title: Establishing the quality policy
clauses.summary: Write a policy that fits the organisation and commits to improvement.

clauses.title: Communicating the quality policy
clauses.summary: Make the policy available, understood and applied.

clauses.title: Organizational roles, responsibilities and authorities
clauses.summary: Assign who does what in the system and tell people.

clauses.title: Planning
clauses.summary: Plan how the system deals with risks and reaches its objectives.

clauses.title: Actions to address risks and opportunities
clauses.summary: Find what could go wrong or better and plan actions for it.

clauses.title: Determining risks and opportunities
clauses.summary: Consider the context and parties to find the risks and opportunities to act on.

clauses.title: Planning actions
clauses.summary: Plan proportionate actions and check they work.

clauses.title: Quality objectives and planning to achieve them
clauses.summary: Set measurable objectives and plan how to reach them.

clauses.title: Setting quality objectives
clauses.summary: Objectives are consistent with the policy, measurable, monitored and updated.

clauses.title: Planning to achieve quality objectives
clauses.summary: Decide what will be done, by whom, with what, by when and how results are judged.

clauses.title: Planning of changes
clauses.summary: Change the system in a planned way, keeping it whole.

clauses.title: Support
clauses.summary: Provide the people, skills, communication and records the system needs.

clauses.title: Resources
clauses.summary: Make sure people, infrastructure and tools are in place.

clauses.title: General
clauses.summary: Decide the resources needed, from inside and outside.

clauses.title: People
clauses.summary: Have the people needed to run the system and its processes.

clauses.title: Infrastructure
clauses.summary: Provide and maintain buildings, equipment, software and transport.

clauses.title: Environment for the operation of processes
clauses.summary: Provide the working conditions processes need.

clauses.title: Monitoring and measuring resources
clauses.summary: Keep measuring equipment fit for use.

clauses.title: General
clauses.summary: Use suitable, maintained resources where results are monitored or measured.

clauses.title: Measurement traceability
clauses.summary: Calibrate or verify equipment where traceability is needed, and act on faults.

clauses.title: Organizational knowledge
clauses.summary: Keep the know-how processes need and share it.

clauses.title: Competence
clauses.summary: Decide the skills each role needs, close gaps and keep proof.

clauses.title: Awareness
clauses.summary: People know the policy, their part in the system and what slipping would mean.

clauses.title: Communication
clauses.summary: Decide what is said, to whom, when and how.

clauses.title: Documented information
clauses.summary: Keep the documents and records the system needs.

clauses.title: General
clauses.summary: Decide which documented information the system needs.

clauses.title: Creating and updating
clauses.summary: Identify, format, review and approve documents.

clauses.title: Control of documented information
clauses.summary: Keep documents available, protected and under change control.

clauses.title: Availability and protection
clauses.summary: Documents are where they are needed and protected from misuse or loss.

clauses.title: Distribution, storage and retention
clauses.summary: Control access, versions, storage, retention and disposal.

clauses.title: Operation
clauses.summary: Run day-to-day work under the controls the system plans.

clauses.title: Operational planning and control
clauses.summary: Plan and control the processes, including changes and outsourced work.

clauses.title: Requirements for products and services
clauses.summary: Agree what customers need and confirm it can be met.

clauses.title: Customer communication
clauses.summary: Talk with customers about offers, orders, feedback and their property.

clauses.title: Determining the requirements for products and services
clauses.summary: Define the requirements, legal ones included.

clauses.title: Review of the requirements for products and services
clauses.summary: Check the organisation can meet what it offers before committing.

clauses.title: Design and development of products and services
clauses.summary: Control design work from inputs to verified outputs.

clauses.summary: Set up a design process where design is needed.

clauses.title: Design and development planning
clauses.summary: Plan stages, reviews, responsibilities and resources.

clauses.title: Design and development inputs
clauses.summary: Gather the requirements a design must meet.

clauses.title: Design and development controls
clauses.summary: Review, verify and validate designs.

clauses.title: Design and development outputs
clauses.summary: Outputs meet the inputs and are fit for later steps.

clauses.title: Design and development changes
clauses.summary: Control and record design changes.

clauses.summary: Evaluate, select and re-evaluate external providers.

clauses.summary: Tell suppliers clearly what is needed.

clauses.title: Production and service provision
clauses.summary: Make products and deliver services under controlled conditions.

clauses.title: Control of production and service provision
clauses.summary: Work to defined conditions, with checks at the right stages.

clauses.title: Identification and traceability
clauses.summary: Identify outputs and their status, and trace them where needed.

clauses.title: Property belonging to customers or external providers
clauses.summary: Look after property owned by customers or suppliers.

clauses.title: Preservation
clauses.summary: Keep outputs in good condition through production and delivery.

clauses.title: Post-delivery activities
clauses.summary: Meet the needs that follow delivery, such as support or warranty.

clauses.title: Control of changes
clauses.summary: Review and control changes in production or service.

clauses.title: Release of products and services
clauses.summary: Release only what has passed its checks.

clauses.title: Control of nonconforming outputs
clauses.summary: Stop faulty output reaching the customer.

clauses.title: Handling nonconforming outputs
clauses.summary: Identify faulty output and correct, segregate, return or accept it under concession.

clauses.title: Records of nonconforming outputs
clauses.summary: Record the problem, the action and who decided.

clauses.title: Performance evaluation
clauses.summary: Check how the system performs.

clauses.title: Monitoring, measurement, analysis and evaluation
clauses.summary: Decide what to measure, measure it and act on the results.

clauses.title: General
clauses.summary: Decide what, how and when to monitor and measure.

clauses.title: Customer satisfaction
clauses.summary: Find out how customers see the organisation's performance.

clauses.title: Analysis and evaluation
clauses.summary: Analyse the data to judge performance and find improvements.

clauses.title: Internal audit
clauses.summary: Audit the system to a plan, with auditors who stay objective.

clauses.title: Purpose of internal audits
clauses.summary: Check the system meets its own and the standard's requirements and works.

clauses.title: Audit programme
clauses.summary: Plan audits by importance and past results, and report and act on them.

clauses.title: Management review
clauses.summary: Top management reviews the system at set intervals.

clauses.title: General
clauses.summary: Hold reviews at planned intervals.

clauses.title: Management review inputs
clauses.summary: What the review looks at.

clauses.title: Management review outputs
clauses.summary: What the review decides, with records.

clauses.title: Improvement
clauses.summary: Keep making the system and its results better.

clauses.title: General
clauses.summary: Look for chances to improve and act on them.

clauses.title: Nonconformity and corrective action
clauses.summary: Contain problems, find their cause and fix it.

clauses.title: Responding to nonconformity
clauses.summary: React, find the cause, act, check the action worked and update the system.

clauses.title: Records of nonconformity
clauses.summary: Record each problem, the action taken and the result.

clauses.title: Continual improvement
clauses.summary: Improve how suitable, adequate and effective the system is over time.
